verses.en: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.pt: Justificados, pois, pela fé, tenhamos paz com Deus, por nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,
verses.en_web: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.en_bbe: For which reason, because we have righteousness through faith, let us be at peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

verses.en: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
verses.pt: por quem obtivemos também nosso acesso pela fé a esta graça, na qual estamos firmes, e gloriemo-nos na esperança da glória de Deus.
verses.en_web: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
verses.en_bbe: Through whom, in the same way, we have been able by faith to come to this grace in which we now are; and let us have joy in hope of the glory of God.

verses.en: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
verses.pt: E não somente isso, mas também gloriemo-nos nas tribulações; sabendo que a tribulação produz a perseverança,
verses.en_web: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;
verses.en_bbe: And not only so, but let us have joy in our troubles: in the knowledge that trouble gives us the power of waiting;

verses.en: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
verses.pt: e a perseverança a experiência, e a experiência a esperança;
verses.en_web: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope:
verses.en_bbe: And waiting gives experience; and experience, hope:

verses.en: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
verses.pt: e a esperança não desaponta, porquanto o amor de Deus está derramado em nossos corações pelo Espírito Santo que nos foi dado.
verses.en_web: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
verses.en_bbe: And hope does not put to shame; because our hearts are full of the love of God through the Holy Spirit which is given to us.

verses.en: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.pt: Pois, quando ainda éramos fracos, Cristo morreu a seu tempo pelos ímpios.
verses.en_web: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.en_bbe: For when we were still without strength, at the right time Christ gave his life for evil-doers.

verses.en: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
verses.pt: Porque dificilmente haverá quem morra por um justo; pois poderá ser que pelo homem bondoso alguém ouse morrer.
verses.en_web: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a righteous person someone would even dare to die.
verses.en_bbe: Now it is hard for anyone to give his life even for an upright man, though it might be that for a good man someone would give his life.

verses.en: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.pt: Mas Deus dá prova do seu amor para conosco, em que, quando éramos ainda pecadores, Cristo morreu por nós.
verses.en_web: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.en_bbe: But God has made clear his love to us, in that, when we were still sinners, Christ gave his life for us.

verses.en: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
verses.pt: Logo muito mais, sendo agora justificados pelo seu sangue, seremos por ele salvos da ira.
verses.en_web: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.
verses.en_bbe: Much more, if we now have righteousness by his blood, will salvation from the wrath of God come to us through him.

verses.en: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
verses.pt: Porque se nós, quando éramos inimigos, fomos reconciliados com Deus pela morte de seu Filho, muito mais, estando já reconciliados, seremos salvos pela sua vida.
verses.en_web: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
verses.en_bbe: For if, when we were haters of God, the death of his Son made us at peace with him, much more, now that we are his friends, will we have salvation through his life;

verses.en: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
verses.pt: E não somente isso, mas também nos gloriamos em Deus por nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, pelo qual agora temos recebido a reconciliação.
verses.en_web: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
verses.en_bbe: And not only so, but we have joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we are now at peace with God.

verses.en: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
verses.pt: Portanto, assim como por um só homem entrou o pecado no mundo, e pelo pecado a morte, assim também a morte passou a todos os homens, porquanto todos pecaram.
verses.en_web: Therefore as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin; and so death passed to all men, because all sinned.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason, as through one man sin came into the world, and death because of sin, and so death came to all men, because all have done evil:

verses.en: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
verses.pt: Porque antes da lei já estava o pecado no mundo, mas onde não há lei o pecado não é levado em conta.
verses.en_web: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.
verses.en_bbe: Because, till the law came, sin was in existence, but sin is not put to the account of anyone when there is no law to be broken.

verses.en: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
verses.pt: No entanto a morte reinou desde Adão até Moisés, mesmo sobre aqueles que não pecaram à semelhança da transgressão de Adão o qual é figura daquele que havia de vir.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.
verses.en_bbe: But still death had power from Adam till Moses, even over those who had not done wrong like Adam, who is a picture of him who was to come.

verses.en: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
verses.pt: Mas não é assim o dom gratuito como a ofensa; porque, se pela ofensa de um morreram muitos, muito mais a graça de Deus, e o dom pela graça de um só homem, Jesus Cristo, abund muitos.
verses.en_web: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
verses.en_bbe: But the free giving of God is not like the wrongdoing of man. For if, by the wrongdoing of one man death came to numbers of men, much more did the grace of God, and the free giving by the grace of one man, Jesus Christ, come to men.

verses.en: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
verses.pt: Também não é assim o dom como a ofensa, que veio por um só que pecou; porque o juízo veio, na verdade, de uma só ofensa para condenação, mas o dom gratuito veio de muitas ofensas para justificação.
verses.en_web: The gift is not as through one who sinned: for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses to justification.
verses.en_bbe: And the free giving has not the same effect as the sin of one: for the effect of one man's sin was punishment by the decision of God, but the free giving had power to give righteousness to wrongdoers in great number.

verses.en: For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
verses.pt: Porque, se pela ofensa de um só, a morte veio a reinar por esse, muito mais os que recebem a abundância da graça, e do dom da justiça, reinarão em vida por um só, Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: For, if by the wrongdoing of one, death was ruling through the one, much more will those to whom has come the wealth of grace and the giving of righteousness, be ruling in life through the one, even Jesus Christ.

verses.en: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
verses.pt: Portanto, assim como por uma só ofensa veio o juízo sobre todos os homens para condenação, assim também por um só ato de justiça veio a graça sobre todos os homens para justificação e vida.
verses.en_web: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.
verses.en_bbe: So then, as the effect of one act of wrongdoing was that punishment came on all men, even so the effect of one act of righteousness was righteousness of life for all men.

verses.en: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
verses.pt: Porque, assim como pela desobediência de um só homem muitos foram constituídos pecadores, assim também pela obediência de um muitos serão constituídos justos.
verses.en_web: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
verses.en_bbe: Because, as numbers of men became sinners through the wrongdoing of one man, even so will great numbers get righteousness through the keeping of the word of God by one man.

verses.en: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
verses.pt: Sobreveio, porém, a lei para que a ofensa abundasse; mas, onde o pecado abundou, superabundou a graça;
verses.en_web: The law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;
verses.en_bbe: And the law came in addition, to make wrongdoing worse; but where there was much sin, there was much more grace:

verses.en: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.pt: para que, assim como o pecado veio a reinar na morte, assim também viesse a reinar a graça pela justiça para a vida eterna, por Jesus Cristo nosso Senhor.
verses.en_web: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.en_bbe: That, as sin had power in death, so grace might have power through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
